_meta.description: Marks which KPIs are FIXED at bank level (everyone scores against the same bank-wide target). Non-fixed KPIs use cascaded individual targets or role-default targets. Per Joshua's v10.318 reminder: CX Score, Audit Score, Staff Productivity etc are bank-wide. v10.323 also marks bank-wide financial outcomes (PBT, Total NFI, NPL Ratio, etc.) since these are organisation-level metrics everyone scores against uniformly.
_meta.rule: A KPI in this list scores everyone against bank_targets[KPI|YEAR]. A KPI NOT in this list scores each staff against their cascaded target (target_cascade), or a role default target (role_default_targets.json), in that order.

_v10324_design_note: True bank-uniform scale KPIs only (CX, Audit, Staff Productivity, CASA Ratio, PAR, Account Dormancy, Channel Dormancy). Aggregate financial outcomes (PBT, Total NFI, NPL Ratio, NIM, ROE, CIR) removed in v10.324 because they need per-staff cascaded or role-default targets, not bank-aggregate (a RM's 150K NFI vs 130bn bank target = 0% achievement).

2026._note: Bank-fixed for 2026: one target for everyone, taken from the MD's scorecard. A KPI listed here ignores per-staff cascade entries.
